state.mechanics: Defeat Head Goon with three ball hits, then reach the right exit alive. One physical ball can rebound and be recovered. His raised tray guards every side; only tray_down allows damage. Each patrol lasts 27 to 81 updates and commits one, two or three separately telegraphed hops before the tray-down opening, independently of health. The current countdown and hops_left report that commitment. The tray-down opening lasts 72 updates. Forecasts crossing a future unobserved patrol assume 54 patrol updates and two hops; those future draws are unknown. A windup locks its landing marker; the hop never retargets in flight. Contact with the living boss hurts during tray_down and flinch too. Defeat is harmless. Kittie's existing damage protection still applies. You can run beneath him when his feet clear your body. Flat arena; shutters at x160 and x320. Defeat opens the right shutter. World x points right, y down; player y is feet. Fresh A jumps on ground or in coyote time; hold for the full arc, release to shorten or rearm. Fresh B throws forward; Up+B lobs higher. Held A or B creates no new press. Prior controls continue during API delay. Structured RAM-assisted observations include current source phase and timing. Derived forecasts approximate source mechanics, not observed future events. Holding A starts a jump only when A was previously released and jumping is available. Continuing to hold A does not trigger another jump.

motion.instructions: Which combined movement and A control best advances Head Goon completion alive? Compare the approximate motion forecasts, committed landing marker, boss phase and world ball. Avoid harmful contact, recover ball, find a useful attack position and reach the exit after defeat. Account for held-button edges and API delay. Choose your own movement; waiting for a ball must not prevent necessary evasion.

criteria.neutral_ground: Move neither direction; release A to shorten ascent or rearm. See its forecast.
criteria.neutral_jump: Move neither direction; press A freshly to jump if ready. See its forecast.
criteria.left_ground: Move left; release A to shorten ascent or rearm. See its forecast.
criteria.left_jump: Move left; press A freshly to jump if ready. See its forecast.
criteria.right_ground: Move right; release A to shorten ascent or rearm. See its forecast.
criteria.right_jump: Move right; press A freshly to jump if ready. See its forecast.

instructions.question: Assume the selected movement action makes Kittie face left. Which B control best uses ball for completion alive? Compare the assumed facing approximate throw forecasts with inventory, B press state and shot feedback. Keep the ball unless a forecast supports damaging the living Head Goon during his tray-down opening. After launching, let that ball's predicted contact resolve before trying another attack. Recover the physical ball for the next opening.

shot_feedback.interpretation: Boss-health decrease confirms a hit. Ball disarming confirms raised-tray contact. Recovery, loss or rest ends flight. Timing and intended contact are forecasts, not observed future events.

criteria.none: Release B; retain ball or rearm a later throw.
criteria.flat: Hold B alone; a fresh press tries a flat throw.
criteria.lob: Hold B and Up; a fresh press tries a high lob.
